title: Koreans struggle more with everyday physical tasks after 75: report
caption:
A new health report tracks how everyday mobility changes for older adults in Korea. The data shows a significant shift in physical function starting in the mid-70s.

Source: Koreaherald - Koreans struggle more with everyday physical tasks after 75: report

https://www.koreaherald.com/article/10915226
